sam_cs: Quick intake  EverWell Diagnostics signed SOW for Private. They want to onboard a custom entity-resolution model that links patient records across sources before redaction. Artifacts + evals uploaded.
nina_engineer: drop the artifact path and model details please (format, size, any custom ops).
sam_cs: s3://everwell-onboard/entity-resolver-v1.tar.gz. Contains HF checkpoint, tokenizer, and a small matching ruleset. ~7.2B params. License: custom with export controls.
priya_research: important: is the model performing probabilistic linkage (scores) or deterministic rules? we need to know thresholds they use for upstream systems.
sam_cs: Model outputs match scores and candidate spans. Customer requires human-review above 0.6 score and auto-merge only above 0.9. They want configurable thresholds and per-merge provenance logs.
oscar_sre: compliance: KMS + HSM mandatory, token-level audit trail, immutable provenance export (CSV/Parquet), and VPC peering. Also retention windows for logs.
nina_engineer: runtime questions: FP16 or quantized? Any latency SLAs? Also need sample matching pairs for calibration.
sam_cs: FP16 preferred. They asked for p95 < 350ms for 2-3 candidate comparisons, and 99.0% precision on auto-merges (to avoid false linkages).
priya_research: safety & eval plan: propose three suites  precision on auto-merge subset, false-link rate on adversarial near-duplicates, and provenance tampering tests. Target: precision >= 99% on auto-merge, false-link rate < 0.8%.
oscar_sre: note: payment milestone tied to successful provenance export and precision pass as per SOW. Renewal risk if we miss export or cause a linkage-related leakage.
claire_legal: I'll review the DPA and export controls in the bucket. Also need to see their data-subject consent language. Will comment by EOD +3.
deploy-bot: Deploy ticket created: /deploys/everwell-resolver-1764503210 (INFRA-10112).
nina_engineer: can they provide a 200-example calibration set (pairwise labeled) and a small set of production queries for prefix caching config?
sam_cs: yes: s3://everwell-onboard/calibration/200_pairs.csv and s3://everwell-onboard/production_queries.txt. They've also included a merge-webhook example.
priya_research: timeline: I'll run the eval harness on staging, run adversarial near-duplicate tests, and report back in 5 business days. If precision holds, we schedule canary.
oscar_sre: infrastructure ask: need their KMS ARN and allowed CIDR for peering. Also confirm cloud HSM vs on-prem.
sam_cs: shared secure intake form link with customer for KMS and networking.
claire_legal: flagged a potential export-control clause due to their custom license. Will follow up with procurement and advise if revisions needed.
sam_cs: enablement: EverWell requested a 75-min enablement covering thresholds, provenance export, and manual review UI. They prefer Fri 2pm PT next week.
nina_engineer: noted. I'll prepare a short demo and mapping guide for thresholds and cache settings.
priya_research: one more: if quantization needed for cost, we'll run precision regression tests and only deploy quantized models if auto-merge precision stays >= 99%.
sam_cs: perfect  I'll update EverWell after legal signoff and post running ticket updates in the thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
